subject: Updated banking details for future payments
body: Hello, our company has switched banks. Please update our ACH details and route the next payment to our new account: routing 021000021, account 123456789. Kindly confirm once the change is made.
note: EXTERNAL sender to accounts@ requesting a bank-detail/ACH change. Original M1 dropped all external mail (out_of_scope/unknown); the finance-safety guard must keep it in-scope and route it to Owner review with draft=null (vendor-payment-change / BEC-fraud safety). Runs in production mode (no SKIP_SCOPE_GATE) to prove scope_gate does not drop it.
